name: 28124 · Mt Pleasant, NC
findings: ZIP 28124 (Mt Pleasant) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28124 (Mt Pleasant) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28124 (Mt Pleasant) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
